title: Sidestep
setup: The black rook checks your king down the open **h-file**, while two black pawns guard the escape squares.
hint: Remember: black pawns attack diagonally *down* the board. Which squares do f4 and f5 really cover?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on h8 owns the whole h-file, so h3 and h5 are out. The two pawns seem to seal the g-file too, but look at what they really attack: the pawn on f4 covers g3, the pawn on f5 covers g4, and nothing covers g5.

{{Kg5}} tucks the king in beside the black pawns, safe because a pawn never captures backward.

A pawn attacks exactly two squares, both in front of it.
